source: NOAA CFSv2 operational forecast archive, noaa-cfs-pds S3
forecast: Four member-01 runs, 00/06/12/18 UTC on first day of previous month; calendar-month PRATE mean converted to total mm
issue: 10th of previous month, nine days after initialization; not the instantaneous publication time
selection: Pooled rolling validation MAE; all recipes fixed before scoring
comparison: Every method scored on identical months. Short-history baselines use same fitted target months as calibrators; long-history baselines/control may use available 1997+ labels.
caveats: Only four runs, not the full CFS ensemble. Different grid and model than NASA target estimates. Short calibration history; known benchmark. Monthly forecast experiment, not a weekly or monthly-nowcast experiment. No missing forecast substitution.
